I can't change the date. Putting a false date in a complaint is a false statement to the Commission and could get your case thrown out, and worse.

The honest options:
- A consumer complaint normally has to be filed within 2 years of when the problem arose. A late complaint can still be accepted if the Commission accepts a good reason for the delay. So the real question is when the problem arose, which may be later than the invoice date (for example, when the product failed or when the seller refused to fix it).
- Because you may be past the time limit, please speak to a lawyer before filing. Free legal aid: 15100.

Tell me when the product actually failed and when the seller refused, and I can help you set out the dates honestly.

open_questions: When did the defect appear and when did the seller refuse?
